correctness.rationale: With vacancy i, the clockwise particle hop is i→i−1 at tilted rate pw_(i−1)e^s, and the other is i→i+1 at qw_(i+1)e^(−s), with p=(1+ε)/2, q=(1−ε)/2. Use the unweighted escape rates in the diagonal. The trace coefficient is a+b+c, since p+q=1. Principal minors do not depend on s because two-edge cycles have zero net count. Their sum is [(1−ε²)(a²+b²+c²)+2(1+ε²)(ab+bc+ca)]/4. The two directed 3-cycles are the only count-sensitive determinant terms, with weights abc p³e^(3s) and abc q³e^(−3s); the determinant vanishes at z=s=0, fixing the remaining constant. This gives the stated reversal-invariant cubic. For real s the tilted matrix is irreducible Metzler, giving a simple analytic dominant real eigenvalue and nonzero positive overlap for stationary initial data. A spectral gap near s=0 identifies its derivatives with long-time cumulant rates; the Legendre transform gives reflected rates (the finite differentiable SCGF permits the finite-state current LDP). At (a,b,c)=(1,2,4), implicit differentiation gives 24ε(ε²+3)/[7(ε²+7)], versus 12ε/7 in the one-particle sector. This asserts no finite-time equality.
